pumac-2023-number-theory-a-07.prompt: Define $f(n)$ to be the smallest integer such that for every positive divisor $d\mid n$, either $n\mid d^d$ or $d^d\mid n^{f(n)}$. How many positive integers $b<1000$ which are not squarefree satisfy the equation $f(2023)\cdot f(b)=f(2023b)$?

pumac-2023-number-theory-a-08.prompt: Let $S_0=0$, $S_1=1$, and for $n\ge2$ let $S_n=S_{n-1}+5S_{n-2}$. What is the sum of the five smallest primes $p$ such that $p\mid S_{p-1}$?
